individualClassifications.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
individualClassifications.reason: Standalone owned JUnit child JVM only: interrupt simulation always clears its own calling thread in finally; eight worker tasks use barrier5SECONDS and Future5SECONDS under TWR. Probe interrupt hook affects only that Test call, never a service or Root/native actor.

individualClassifications.message: If you run in Java5 or newer and have concurrent access, you should use the ConcurrentHashMap implementation
individualClassifications.reason: Each parallel task constructs its own Probe after the rendezvous; Probe.faults belongs to that one worker and is seeded/read synchronously. Parent inspection follows Future completion. Nonparallel fixtures never share this mutable map.

individualClassifications.message: In J2EE, getClassLoader() might not work as expected. Use Thread.currentThread().getContextClassLoader() instead.
individualClassifications.reason: JDK JDBC interface Proxy uses the exact defining loader of its one supplied interface and an array containing only that same interface. No TCCL/provider lookup or external connection is performed.
